sloka: ततो विभीषणो नाम तस्य भ्राता महामतिः ।तेन राक्षसराजो ऽसौ याचितो मम कारणात् ।। ५.५८.१४५ ।।।।
transliteration: tato vibhīṣaṇo nāma tasya bhrātā mahāmatiḥ ।tena rākṣasarājo 'sau yācito mama kāraṇāt ।। 5.58.145 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vibhisana, a very pious brother of the demon king, interceded on my behalf.
